title: 空心变压器的反映阻抗
statement: 空心变压器：U̇s = 150∠0° V（有效值），ω = 100 rad/s，原边电阻 R1 = 3 Ω，L1 = 0.2 H，L2 = 0.08 H，M = 0.1 H，副边接负载 RL = 6 Ω。
用原边等效电路（反映阻抗）求从 a 端看进去的输入阻抗 Z_in = R_in + jX_in（不含 Us），以及负载功率 P_L。

questions.ask: 输入电阻 R_in = Re Z_in = ?
questions.explain: Z22 = RL + jωL2 = 6 + j8 Ω，反映阻抗 Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z22 = 100/(6 + j8) = 6 − j8 Ω。Z_in = R1 + jωL1 + Z_ref = 3 + j20 + 6 − j8 = 9 + j12 Ω，R_in = 9 Ω。

questions.ask: 输入电抗 X_in = Im Z_in = ?
questions.explain: X_in = ωL1 + Im Z_ref = 20 − 8 = 12 Ω：副边的感性阻抗反映到原边变成了容性（−j8），使原边的电抗减小。
I1 = 150 / |9 + j12| = 150 / 15 = 10 A。负载功率就是反映电阻吸收的功率：P_L = I1² × Re Z_ref = 100 × 6 = 600 W（也可由 I2 = ωM·I1/|Z22| = 10 A，P_L = I2²·RL 验证）。

questions.ask: 副边回路 Z22 = 6 + j8 Ω 是感性的，它在原边的反映阻抗是：
questions.explain: Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z22 = (ωM)²·Z22*/|Z22|²，与 Z22 共轭成比例：电阻部分同号，电抗部分变号。感性的副边反映为容性。

hints: 原边等效电路：Z_in = Z11 + (ωM)²/Z22，其中 Z11 = R1 + jωL1，Z22 = RL + jωL2。
反映阻抗的电阻部分吸收的功率，就是副边实际消耗的功率。

en.title: Reflected impedance of an air-core transformer
statement: Air-core transformer: Us = 150∠0° V (rms), ω = 100 rad/s, primary resistance R1 = 3 Ω, L1 = 0.2 H, L2 = 0.08 H, M = 0.1 H, and a load RL = 6 Ω on the secondary.
Using the primary equivalent circuit (reflected impedance), find the input impedance Z_in = R_in + jX_in seen at terminal a (without Us), and the load power P_L.

questions.explain: Z22 = RL + jωL2 = 6 + j8 Ω, reflected impedance Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z22 = 100/(6 + j8) = 6 − j8 Ω. Z_in = R1 + jωL1 + Z_ref = 3 + j20 + 6 − j8 = 9 + j12 Ω, so R_in = 9 Ω.
X_in = ωL1 + Im Z_ref = 20 − 8 = 12 Ω: the inductive secondary is reflected as a capacitive term (−j8), which reduces the primary reactance.
I1 = 150 / |9 + j12| = 150 / 15 = 10 A. The load power is the power absorbed by the reflected resistance: P_L = I1² × Re Z_ref = 100 × 6 = 600 W (check: I2 = ωM·I1/|Z22| = 10 A, P_L = I2²·RL).

questions.ask: The secondary loop Z22 = 6 + j8 Ω is inductive. Its reflected impedance in the primary is…
questions.explain: Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z22 = (ωM)²·Z22*/|Z22|² is proportional to the conjugate of Z22: the resistance keeps its sign and the reactance flips. An inductive secondary reflects as a capacitive impedance.

hints: Primary equivalent circuit: Z_in = Z11 + (ωM)²/Z22 with Z11 = R1 + jωL1 and Z22 = RL + jωL2.
The power absorbed by the resistive part of the reflected impedance is exactly the power consumed in the secondary.
solution: **2. Reflected impedance.** Z_ref = (ωM)²/Z22 = 100/(6 + j8) = 6 − j8 Ω.
**3. Input impedance.** Z_in = Z11 + Z_ref = **9 + j12 Ω** = 15∠53.13° Ω (R_in = 9 Ω, X_in = 12 Ω).
**4. Primary and secondary currents.** I1 = 150/Z_in = 10∠−53.13° A; from the secondary equation (RL + jωL2)I2 = jωM·I1 (I2 as drawn): I2 = ωM·I1/|Z22| = 10 × 10/10 = 10 A.
**5. Power.** P_L = I2²·RL = **600 W** = I1²·Re Z_ref ✓; R1 dissipates 300 W, and the source delivers P = 150 × 10 × cos 53.13° = 900 W = 300 + 600 ✓.
